ambient_events: The fountains drop for a second, then come back up.
Somebody sits on the edge of the basin and eats a hot dog over the water.
A groundskeeper picks ticket stubs out of a hedge one at a time.
description: Hughson Gardens, a parterre of clipped box fanned out like the sun over the Coliseum's gate and filled with red, white and gold bedding. A gilt-tipped obelisk stands in the middle. There's a sign asking you not to sit on the hedges.
name: Hughson Gardens
